sub_parameters.name: Label
sub_parameters.description:
The common scenario for text detection. Valid values:

- spam: spam text detection

- politics: sensitive text detection

- abuse: abuse text detection

- terrorism: terrorism text detection

- porn: pornographic text detection

- flood: flood text detection

- contraband: contraband text detection

- ad: advertising text detection.

sub_parameters.name: Content
sub_parameters.description:
The object to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is a text detection task structure.

> - N Tasks are counted as N calls for billing purposes.
